text: Perdurantism holds that what persists is not any single momentary stage but the four-dimensional ___ — the whole entity composed of all of an object's temporal parts, analogous to how a snake is extended through space.
explanation: The expected answer is 'temporal worm.' On perdurantism (four-dimensionalism), ordinary object-terms refer to the temporal worm composed of temporal parts (time-slices), just as a spatial worm like a snake is composed of spatial parts. The individual momentary slices are its temporal parts or stages, not the whole persisting object.
